rule: Craigslist used-car listings across the US, posted April–May 2021
id, image_url, region_url, posting_date and county dropped: ids, links, one month of dates, an empty column
listings with a $0 price (no price given)
built before 1980 or no year: classics follow different pricing
the ~400 craigslist regions dropped, state is kept instead
dropped: it overlaps with model
under $500, under $1,000 for a 2010+ car, over $200k, or a 2021+ car under $5k (a financing price)
missing → 'unknown'
missing → 'missing', rare colours → 'not ordinary'
missing → first word of the model if it's a known brand (typos like 'chevorlet' fixed), else 'unknown'
no year (already removed by the 1980 step)
raw model text → clean base model with Claude; rare names → 'other', missing → 'unknown'
missing, over 500,000 miles, or under 100 miles on a pre-2020 car
no fuel type
no title status
electric → 'other', hybrid → 4 cylinders, else the model's most common; still unknown → dropped
no transmission
missing → the model's most common type, else 'unknown'
missing → the model's drive when 80%+ of its listings agree, else 'unknown'
same values in every column except state and the raw listing fields: the same car posted again
url, VIN, description and lat / long turned into is_dealer, has_vin, desc_len and keyword flags
